QuestInfo.name: The Chief Wolf's Rage
QuestInfo.0: You may have lost, then found your #t1902017#, but you wish to raise it in a healthy environment. What should you do? You'd better head over to #b#m914030000##k of #b#m140000000##k and see #b#p1202008##k.
QuestInfo.1: #p1202008# unleashed his anger on you for not taking care of their cub properly and asked you to bring #t4032334# again...\n\n#i4032334# #t4032334# #b#c4032334# / 1#k
QuestInfo.2: You made another #t4032334# and with that, you were able to raise #t1902017# into an adult wolf. You promise to never, ever lose your wolf again.

0.0: I had always thought you were a decent enough person to take care of our baby...but I guess I was wrong. Why did our baby shrink? Did you hurt his feelings? I cannot let this go on any longer. I cannot let a negligent person provide the love our baby needs to grow!\n#b#L0#(You emphatically state that you still want to raise the wolf and will do better in the future.)#l\n#k
0.1: ...Are you really repenting for your mistakes? Humans are foolish...but your sincere attitude is what makes me want to give you a second chance.

yes.0: If you bring back the #b#t4032334##k to restore the cub, I shall forgive you. #b#t4032334##k can be obtained from #r#o8190003##k in Leafre.

no.0: Are you not repenting, you foolish human? If you do not ask for forgiveness, then we'll take back the kid!

1.0: Did you bring the #t4032334#? Okay, let's give it to our baby.

yes.0: Do not ever hurt Ryko's feelings again. You have already promised to be Ryko's partner for life.

item.0: Bring back the #b#t4032334##k with the little one. Since you've done this before, you should have no problem doing it again, I imagine.
